hypotheses.title: Unauthenticated Access to Sensitive Data
hypotheses.description: An attacker may be able to access sensitive data without proper authentication.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Implement authentication and authorization mechanisms to restrict access to sensitive data.

hypotheses.title: Insufficient Input Validation
hypotheses.description: An attacker may be able to inject malicious input, potentially leading to security vulnerabilities.
hypotheses.recommendedNextStep: Implement robust input validation and sanitization mechanisms to prevent malicious input.
